title: Task
description: A task runs one or more strategies (strategy_ids) or one inline batch spec, with its own output routing and an aggregate flow-control ceiling. The task ceiling caps the total without rewriting any strategy envelope.

strategy_ids.title: Strategy ids
strategy_ids.description: Strategies to run together (at least one). Either this or batch, not both.

batch.title: Batch spec
batch.description: Inline mixed-traffic batch (multiple protocol classes in one engine task). Either this or strategy_ids, not both.

output_type.title: Output type
output_type.description: port_group sends to wire interfaces; pcap writes a file; both sends to the port group AND mirrors the stream to a pcap file (shadow capture, flow-table analysis applies).

output_config.title: Output configuration
output_config.description: Output routing fields matching output_type: port_group_id for port_group/both (pcap_path optional for both, shadow path auto-generated), pcap_path for pcap.

flow_control.title: Task flow control
flow_control.description: Aggregate ceiling over all strategies/classes. Never rewrites strategy envelopes.
